risks.risk: Wrong console model (e.g., Xbox One S vs One X vs PS4) or not disc-free; photos don’t show any identifying label/ports.
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo of the console model label/serial sticker (bottom/back) and a photo of the disc drive area (or confirmation it has no disc slot).

risks.risk: Not tested / may be faulty (no power-on, no HDMI/video output, no controller pairing shown).
risks.proof: Ask for a short video clip showing power-on, dashboard loading on TV, and controller pairing.

risks.risk: Missing accessories (power cable, HDMI cable, controller, stand) or incomplete bundle.
risks.proof: Ask for a laid-out photo of everything included (console + controller(s) + cables + box contents).
risks.if_unproven: Price as console only with unknown missing accessories.

risks.risk: Condition issues hidden by plastic wrap (scratches, dents, overheating, damaged ports).
risks.proof: Ask for close-up photos of ports (HDMI, power), vents, and any visible damage without plastic wrap.
risks.if_unproven: Price as average used condition with possible cosmetic/port wear.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the console’s model/serial label (bottom/back) showing it is Xbox One S All-Digital.
Short video: power on + TV display + controller pairing (showing it boots).
Photo/video of the disc area confirming disc-free (no disc slot) or showing the drive status.
Laid-out accessories photo: controller(s), power brick/cable, HDMI cable, and any included items.
